Goto Survey Viewer

Inspecting what lies beneath the terminals

Explore the work

ProjectsResearchExpeditionsDiscuss a project

I built a scan viewer and labeling tool for Rijkswaterstaat to inspect underwater survey outputs and analyze marine debris beneath Bonaire's Goto terminals.

Client: Rijkswaterstaat.

Location and year: Bonaire, 2026.

My contribution: underwater surveys, imagery processing, viewer and labeling tool development, and technical reporting.

Connecting survey imagery with inspection

The assignment combined underwater documentation with tools for reviewing the results. I processed the imagery into 3D reconstructions and orthomosaics, then built an interface for inspecting those outputs and labeling debris.

What I delivered

  • A scan viewer for inspecting the survey outputs.
  • A labeling tool to support debris analysis.
  • 3D reconstructions and orthomosaics.
  • Technical reports documenting coverage and survey outputs.

Making the work usable

The viewer gives the survey imagery a practical role in the inspection process. It connects the visual record of conditions beneath the terminals with the task of identifying and analyzing debris.
